summary: The `ansible.builtin.selectattr` filter filters objects by applying a test to an attribute, keeping only those that pass; it's Jinja's builtin selectattr filter.
questions: How do I filter a list of dicts by the value of a key?
How do I select only items where an attribute is true?

answer_card.title: selectattr filter
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.selectattr` filters a sequence of objects by applying a test to the specified attribute of each, keeping only the objects where the test succeeds. It's Jinja's builtin `selectattr` filter.
